response.why: Critical blocking decision during opponent's Turn 16 attack. Opponent at 4 life (lethal range). Leaf 3 (block Kaito) optimal: minimizes damage taken (5 damage → stay at 16 life) despite losing Deep-Cavern Bat. Opponent attacking with Restless Reef 4/4, Floodpits Drowner 2/1, and Kaito 7/8. Leaf 0 (no blocks) catastrophic: takes 13 damage, down to 8 life—unnecessary risk when Kaito block available. Leaf 1 (block Restless Reef) acceptable but suboptimal: 8 damage → 13 life. Leaf 2 (block Floodpits Drowner) inferior: 10 damage → 11 life. Must prioritize life total preservation for upcoming turns despite losing creature.
